description: Decode a SAMLRequest or SAMLResponse (Base64, or deflate + Base64) and summarise it. Signatures are not verified. Operations: "decode" — Decode a SAML message and return its issuer, status, NameID, audience, conditions, validity window, attributes and pretty-printed XML. Signatures are reported, never verified.. Call with "operation" plus "input" (and "options" where relevant). Not repeatable: decode returns a different result on each call.

input.description: The SAMLRequest/SAMLResponse value (Base64 for HTTP-POST, deflate + Base64 for HTTP-Redirect), a URL or form body containing it, or the XML.

operation.description: decode — Decode a SAML message and return its issuer, status, NameID, audience, conditions, validity window, attributes and pretty-printed XML. Signatures are reported, never verified.

options.description: Options for the chosen operation (each says which operations use it).

name: saml-decoder
title: SAML Decoder
